Needs changes before merge.

The explicit upright opening assertions agree with the #3300 pose rule. The exact rapid inheritance comparisons remain in place. The ball and flank checks remain in place. No production code, UI, fixture, recorded program, or golden changes. This is not a safety-tier production change.

Results locally:

The trial merge with upstream/main 835556814a9dc79ce7669320f402184b8ac7f8af failed in all three changed test files. Main already contains the #3486 correction from PR #3505. I did not resolve the code conflicts. I aborted the merge and ran the checks on the PR head. There is no trial merge commit, so HEAD^1 cannot identify a merged PR head.

- Quick gate: PASS, four steps. All three named pins passed.
- Full multiaxis suite: PASS, 7 tests.
- Full multiaxis_avoid suite: PASS, 6 tests.
- Full multiaxis_rough suite: PASS, 5 tests.
- Motion clippy, all targets, with -D warnings: PASS.
- git diff --check: PASS.

Extra suites run:

- motion golden_undercut: PASS, 4 tests.
- motion machining2d: PASS, 68 tests.
- app suites: example_catalog: PASS, 37 tests; 4 existing heavy tests ignored.
- No fixture or importer change requires the additional STEP suites.

Heavy lanes:

I ran cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main locally on this PR head. The release build passed. The selected motion heavy: multiaxis, multiaxis_avoid, and multiaxis_rough steps passed. Each ran zero ignored tests. These binaries contain no ignored tests. The gate uses merge base fd64cc2 for the diff; this run does not test a merge with current main.

Mutations: Not run. This PR changes test expectations only. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, gouge check, or collision check. No goldens moved.

Requested before merge:

1. crates/motion/tests/multiaxis.rs:173, crates/motion/tests/multiaxis_avoid.rs:173, crates/motion/tests/multiaxis_rough.rs:157: resolve the conflicts with current upstream/main. Keep the current main checks that prove the fixture leans. Keep the explicit opening assertions. Run the checks again on the refreshed head.
2. PR body, Tests and Not exercised: add the required P2 heavy-lane report for the final head against current upstream/main. Name the base, head, selected lanes, results, and zero-test counts where applicable. The body currently says the release heavy lanes were not run. The local results above do not cover the conflicting trial merge.

No review images or evidence were committed. The warm review worktree and branch remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: None. The conflict stop rule blocks this fix round.

The merge of upstream/main 835556814a9dc79ce7669320f402184b8ac7f8af into ff69c31f81b6537082d5c3dce933470081959634 conflicts in three hunks:

- crates/motion/tests/multiaxis.rs:173, rapids_hold_the_pose_they_inherit. Both sides change the inherited pose setup. Main adds the lean assertion. The PR adds the opening assertion.
- crates/motion/tests/multiaxis_avoid.rs:173, dodging_never_moves_the_ball. Both sides change the inherited pose setup. Main adds the lean assertion. The PR adds the opening assertion.
- crates/motion/tests/multiaxis_rough.rs:157, rapids_hold_inherited_pose_and_flanks_lean. Both sides change the inherited pose setup and its explanation.

The fix instructions require a stop when both sides change the same logic. I aborted the merge. No commits or files were discarded. The warm worktree fix-3492 remains clean at ff69c31f81b6537082d5c3dce933470081959634.

No fix was pushed. Mutation checks, quick gate, heavy lanes, catalog checks, and clippy were not run. The final-head heavy report remains pending. A re-review is not requested because the findings remain open.

Addressed: None. The same-logic conflict stop rule blocks this round.

The warm worktree was clean and matched origin/issue/3486-multiaxis-opening-pose-tests.
Head: ff69c31f81b6537082d5c3dce933470081959634.
Current upstream/main: 835556814a9dc79ce7669320f402184b8ac7f8af.

The merge conflicts in these inherited-pose setup hunks:

- crates/motion/tests/multiaxis.rs:173, rapids_hold_the_pose_they_inherit. Main adds the lean check. The PR adds the opening check. Both change the setup and its explanation.
- crates/motion/tests/multiaxis_avoid.rs:173, dodging_never_moves_the_ball. Main adds the lean check. The PR adds the opening check. Both change the inherited pose setup.
- crates/motion/tests/multiaxis_rough.rs:157, rapids_hold_inherited_pose_and_flanks_lean. Both change the inherited pose setup and its explanation.

The fix instructions require a stop when both sides change the same logic. I aborted the merge. The worktree remains clean at the original head. No commit or file was discarded.

Both review findings remain open. No fix was pushed. Mutation checks, quick gate, heavy lanes, catalog checks, and clippy were not run. The final-head heavy report remains pending.

Please re-review these conflict hunks before another fix round. This comment does not claim that either finding is fixed.

Fact: main already has this correction.

Commit `835556814` (PR #3505, `test(multiaxis): re-pin the inherited rapid pose to the upright home`) is on main. It changes the same three test files and the same inherited-pose assertions.

The net diff of this branch against main removes 23 lines that main now has. A merge moves main back.

The merge conflict that you report is the same-logic case. The stop rule is correct.

Recommendation: close this PR without a merge. The work it carried is on main.

The label stays `needs-rework` until the owner decides.

Fix round for review `ff69c31f8`. New head: 81008d26a873f0aa4ecdf32558067e78401cd4ad.

1. Conflicts with upstream/main (multiaxis.rs:173, multiaxis_avoid.rs:173, multiaxis_rough.rs:157):
   - I merged upstream/main 6e641dac7 with a merge commit. I did not rebase.
   - The two sides are compatible. Main adds the lean checks. The PR adds the opening check.
   - Each hunk keeps the text and all checks of main.
   - Each hunk adds one line: `moves[0].axis == Some([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])`.
   - The net diff against main now only adds three assertions, renames the roughing test, and corrects two stale comments. It removes no check of main.
   - Pins: `rapids_hold_the_pose_they_inherit`, `dodging_never_moves_the_ball`, `rapids_hold_inherited_pose_and_flanks_lean`.
   - Mutation: each opening assertion set to `None` makes all three pins fail. Restore makes them pass.
   - Full suites pass: multiaxis 7, multiaxis_avoid 6, multiaxis_rough 5.

2. PR body heavy report:
   - The body now has the heavy-lane report for head 81008d26a against base upstream/main 6e641dac7.
   - `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: release build ok. The motion heavy steps multiaxis, multiaxis_avoid and multiaxis_rough are ok. Each ran 0 ignored tests, because these binaries have none.
   - The body also states that main has PR #3505.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green (four steps). Motion clippy with `-D warnings` is green.

Note for the owner: the remaining value of this PR is the explicit check of the first move. The owner can still close it if main is sufficient.

Please re-review.
